plan.notes: SOURCE: Official NDSU University Catalog 2024-2025 (archived edition). Semester sequence transcribed from the official catalog 'Sample Program Guide' for Biological Sciences, standard emphasis (Total Credits: 120); course titles verified against the official Biological Sciences requirements table (undergraduate/program-curriculum/biological-sciences). HONESTY NOTE: NDSU labels these 'Sample Program Guide' with a disclaimer that they are not the official curriculum for current students; individual plans vary. This is the only semester-by-semester sequence NDSU publishes for this major. The standard emphasis requires 15 credits of 300-400 level BIOL (the plan's BIOL 300-400 elective slots total exactly 15). BIOL 189 required only for first-time, first-year students. CHEM 240 recorded at 3 credits per the plan (the two-semester organic sequence CHEM 341/341L + 342/342L is 8 credits); PHYS 120 recorded at 3 credits per the plan (the College Physics I/II sequence with labs is 8 credits).
